name: George Orwell
summary: Orwell described himself as a democratic socialist who opposed totalitarianism of left and right. He favoured nationalising major industry, capping incomes and ending class and hereditary privilege, backed revolution understood as a shift of power rather than a class dictatorship, and rejected pacifism, imperialism and nationalism while defending a patriotism tied to English life.
